objective: Test bounded column-mode reading and measure the dual-channel agreement ceiling: transcribe every detector-derived column with a count-anchored token ceiling using the frozen Gemini reader identity, assemble pages deterministically, pair against the existing full-page transcriptions, and measure consensus precision where the two independent channels agree.
hypothesis: Column-mode reading with count-anchored ceilings produces zero runaway columns, improves CER on at least two of the three catastrophic pages, and characters where the full-page and column channels agree match gold with at least 0.99 precision on healthy pages, establishing that near-zero silent error is achievable through agreement plus focused adjudication.
